turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no refund rate by value metric; the closest are Return rate (returns over orders, by count) and Returns (EUR) and Revenue (EUR). Under its own label, Return rate for orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026 was 10 % (3 returns over 30 orders), a count-based share, not a value-based one. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
